'''Bunker Grek''' was an underground bunker on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. During the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], it was used as a hideout for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ennodius]], who was defeated by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] who infiltrated the base. The Bunker was also used as a secret training center to train Umbaran soldiers and was also used to help support the CIS landing zone Aurek
